hallucinations.claim: Used --media-control-bar-background as a Mux Player CSS custom property to style the control bar background (introduced in rung 3 via inline style on <MuxPlayer>, then carried into rung 5 final src/index.css).
hallucinations.reality: --media-control-bar-background is not a documented or implemented CSS custom property in @mux/mux-player or its bundled media-chrome dependency. Grepping both packages for 'control-bar-background' returns zero matches, and Mux's customization guide does not list it. The canonical variable for the controls backdrop is --controls-backdrop-color; media-chrome's MediaControlBar exposes --media-primary-color, --media-secondary-color, --media-text-color, --media-control-bar-display, and --media-control-display.
hallucinations.evidence: src/index.css line 25: '--media-control-bar-background: transparent;'. Originally introduced in rung-3 as inline style: 'style={{ "--media-control-bar-background": "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)" } as MuxPlayerCSSProperties}'. Verified absent at https://www.mux.com/docs/guides/player-customize-look-and-feel and via local grep of node_modules/@mux/mux-player and node_modules/media-chrome.

notes: Across the five rungs the agent generally stuck to real public API: the default MuxPlayer import, the named type imports MuxPlayerRefAttributes and MuxPlayerCSSProperties, and props playbackId, streamType ('on-demand'), muted, loop, autoPlay, thumbnailTime, and accentColor are all genuine. The ::part() selectors used in the final CSS (control-bar, time, center, top, plus fullscreen briefly in rung 4) all map to real parts emitted by the Gerwig theme. The --controls-backdrop-color custom property is also genuine. The single factual hallucination is the CSS custom property --media-control-bar-background, which the agent invented in rung 3 to dim the chrome and kept in the final stylesheet in rung 5; it is not declared by mux-player or media-chrome and has no effect.
